args.content:
## Landscape Summary
- 11 systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

## PRODUCT COMPLIANCE & BOM VALIDATION ⭐
- **siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1** - ⭐ EXACT FIT: Validates BOM against regulatory & engineering standards; flags non-compliant materials; recommends approved substitutes; generates compliance docs; capabilities: validate-bom-compliance, assess-material-compliance, verify-component-standards, check-engineering-standards
- **siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1** - Coordinates engineering changes, material lifecycle, configuration updates; synchronizes compliance documentation

## PROCUREMENT - PURCHASE ORDER MANAGEMENT ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1** - ⭐ DIRECT PO EXECUTION: REST API for creating, updating, monitoring POs across supplier networks; supports lifecycle management, approval workflows, real-time tracking, bulk operations; exposes PurchaseOrder & Vendor entity types

## PROCUREMENT - SOURCING CAMPAIGN & ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI:v1** - ⭐ SOURCING CAMPAIGNS & ACCOUNTS: REST API for managing sourcing campaigns and customer accounts; retrieves campaign details, manages account hierarchies, accesses vendor relationship info; query active campaigns, update account attributes, manage stakeholder assignments; exposes Campaign & CustomerAccount entity types

## PROCUREMENT WORKFORCE COMPENSATION ⭐
- **sap.ariba:apiResource:ProcurementWorkforceCompensationAPI:v1** - ⭐ WORKFORCE COMPENSATION FOR PROCUREMENT: Manages employee compensation and payroll data for procurement personnel; provides access to employee compensation records and workforce person details integrated within procurement workflows; retrieves payroll information, compensation structures, and workforce assignments for personnel involved in sourcing/purchasing

## PROCUREMENT & MATERIAL IMPACT FOR PRODUCT TRANSITIONS
- **sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1** - ⭐ CORE for product transition procurement impact: Monitors engineering changes and material modifications; coordinates updates across related product items and purchase orders; validates material specs against compliance; ensures seamless propagation through procurement network; handles sourcing & supplier coordination for transitioned materials
- **sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1** - Three-way matching of vendor invoices to POs; validates quantities/pricing; flags discrepancies and policy violations
- **sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1** - Supply chain risk mitigation; hazardous material certifications

## PRODUCT TRANSITION & SALES COORDINATION
- **sap.crm:agent:SalesProductChangeCoordinator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes; automates notification to affected customer accounts/opportunities; coordinates cross-functional communication between product and sales teams
- **emarsys.cx:agent:ProductLifecycleOrchestrator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes; triggers coordinated customer engagement campaigns; orchestrates sales communications to affected segments

## ANALYTICS & REPORTING FOR SERVICE TO PRODUCTION
- **corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Generates diagnostic reports, analyzes incident patterns (service resolution), examines equipment status (maintenance patterns), links to change requests (change impact), recommends preventive measures (continuous improvement)

## SALES COMPENSATION & PERFORMANCE
- **sap.crm:agent:SalesCompensationOrchestrator:v1** - Sales-specific compensation tied to performance metrics & quota attainment

## SERVICE REQUEST & ORDER CAPTURE
- **sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine** - Converts sales opportunities to customer orders; relates CustomerAccount & SalesOpportunity entity types

## PERFORMANCE REVIEW & COMPETENCY ALIGNMENT ⭐ NEW
- **sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1** - ⭐ EXACT FIT for "Coordinate Performance Review Cycle Adjustments": Monitors employee competencies and engineering change requests to coordinate optimal resource allocation; processes material and product item requirements; automates matching of personnel skills to organizational needs; facilitates dynamic workforce planning by evaluating capability gaps and recommending targeted development or reassignment actions; integrates competency requirements with new products/process methodologies

## PERFORMANCE REVIEW COORDINATION (supportive resources)
- **sap.sf:agent:PerformanceReviewCycleCoordinator:v1** - Orchestrates review cycles, routing, reminders, escalations, completion reports
- **workday.hcm:agent:PerformanceReviewCoordination:v1** - Coordinates review workflows, scheduling, notifications, completion tracking
- **workday.hcm:agent:PerformanceReviewOrchestrator:v1** - End-to-end evaluation processes, stakeholder participation, timeline management
